title: Air Conditioner Manufacturing Compliance and Monitoring
summary: This thread tracks the evolution of regulatory requirements for domestic air conditioner manufacturers, shifting from general industrial incentives to specific, rigorous monitoring of raw material usage and production compliance. Over time, the framework introduced mandatory local production thresholds, periodic physical inspections by VAT committees, and standardized reporting formats for raw material consumption.

evolution.regulatory_oversight: Transitioned from general industrial status to a specific, committee-led bi-annual physical verification process.
evolution.eligibility: Defined strict criteria for manufacturers, requiring both Industrial IRC and VAT compliance.
evolution.production_standards: Introduced mandatory local manufacturing of at least three critical components.

timeline.change: Established formal criteria for 'Industrial IRC holder' and 'VAT compliant' manufacturers, mandated local production of at least three key components, and instituted a joint committee for bi-annual physical inspection of production facilities.
Reaffirmed and updated the procedural requirements for raw material declaration and compliance monitoring, maintaining the oversight structure established in 2022.

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the issuing authority for the customs documentation requirements related to the manufacturing of air conditioners.
H.S. Code: The declaration process requires the identification of finished products and their constituent raw materials by their specific classification codes.

(১) (ক) আমদানিকারক প্রতিষ্ঠানকে অবশ্যই Industrial IRC holder VAT compliant এয়ারকন্ডিশনার উৎপাদনকারী (Manufacturer) হইতে হইবে।

ব্যাখ্যা-
(অ) “Industrial IRC holder” অর্থ এইরূপ প্রতিষ্ঠান যাহার নিকট আমদানি ও রপ্তানি প্রধান নিয়ন্ত্রকের দপ্তর হইতে ইস্যুকৃত হালনাগাদ শিল্প ভোক্তা (Industrial Consumer) আইআরসি রহিয়াছে;
(আ) “VAT compliant” অর্থ মূল্য সংযোজন কর ও সম্পূরক শুল্ক আইন, ২০১২ এর অধীনে নিবন্ধিত নিয়মিত দাখিলপত্র (রিটার্ন) দাখিল করে এইরূপ উৎপাদনকারী প্রতিষ্ঠান;

(খ) এয়ারকন্ডিশনার উৎপাদনকারী প্রতিষ্ঠানকে নিম্নলিখিত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অংশসমূহ হইতে ন্যূনতম তিনটি অংশ উৎপাদন করিতে হইবে; যথা:-
i) Condenser
ii) Evaporator
iii) Outdoor body
iv) Heat Shrinkable Tube/Sanction and discharge tube.

Industrial IRC Holder: This entity refers to an establishment that holds an up-to-date Industrial Consumer Import Registration Certificate issued by the Office of the Chief Controller of Imports and Exports.
An importer must possess this status to be eligible for the defined manufacturing criteria.
VAT Compliant: A manufacturer is considered VAT compliant if it is registered under the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012, and consistently submits its required tax returns.
Manufacturer: A manufacturer of air conditioners must meet specific criteria, including holding an Industrial IRC and being VAT compliant.
To qualify, the manufacturer must also produce at least three out of four specified critical components: the condenser, evaporator, outdoor body, or heat shrinkable tubes.
Industrial Consumer: This category defines the status of an entity eligible to hold an Industrial Import Registration Certificate for the purpose of receiving customs concessions.
Value Added Tax: The regulatory framework for this tax, alongside Supplementary Duty, dictates the compliance and return-filing requirements for manufacturers.

Industrial IRC Holder: Office of the Chief Controller of Imports and Exports
VAT Compliant: Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012

Verification Committee: The Commissioner of the concerned Value Added Tax Commissionerate is required to form a committee comprising a Joint Commissioner and a Divisional Officer to verify the production of air conditioners.
The committee must conduct physical inspections every six months and submit findings to the Commissioner.
Value Added Tax Commissionerate: The Commissionerate oversees the monitoring of imported parts and materials to ensure they are used in accordance with approved input-output coefficients.
Customs House: Upon receiving reports from the Value Added Tax Commissionerate regarding discrepancies in the usage of imported goods, the Customs House must evaluate the findings and initiate necessary reassessment or corrective customs procedures.
Input-Output Coefficient: This serves as the regulatory standard for determining the legitimate consumption of imported components during the manufacturing process of air conditioners.

Customs Clearance: The appropriate officer must verify compliance with all established conditions regarding the import and customs clearance process.
Customs clearance must be approved by the relevant Deputy Commissioner or Assistant Commissioner.
Business Identification Number: Customs officials must verify the authenticity of the Business Identification Number using authorized customs or VAT online systems and official government websites to avoid processing delays.
National Board of Revenue: The official website of the National Board of Revenue is designated as a source for verifying taxpayer registration information during the customs clearance process.
Customs Computerised Entry Processing Sy: This system is used by customs officials to verify taxpayer information and ensure regulatory compliance during the import process.
Value Added Tax Commissionerate: The website of the VAT Commissionerate is an authorized portal for the verification of taxpayer registration documents.
Importation of Goods: Details of every consignment cleared under this notification must be formally communicated to the relevant VAT authorities.
Importers are required to provide a formal undertaking stating that the imported raw materials or components will be utilized specifically for the manufacturing of air conditioners.

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the issuing authority for this regulatory form regarding the declaration of raw materials and inputs for air conditioner production.
Value Added Tax: The registration number for Value Added Tax is a mandatory requirement for businesses declaring inputs for the manufacturing of air conditioners.
H.S. Code: The declaration form requires the specification of H.S. Code for both the finished products and the individual raw materials or inputs used in the production process.
Commissioner of Customs: The relevant Commissioner of Customs is required to provide a countersignature on the declaration form submitted by the manufacturing entity.
